name: schema
description: Row schema version emitted by Telemetry.SCHEMA_VERSION (currently 1).

name: event_name
description: Snake_case event name, sanitized to [a-z0-9_]{1,40}.

name: event_ts_us
description: Event time, microseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

name: event_date
description: UTC calendar date derived from event_ts_us by tools/bq_load.py. Partition column.

name: user_pseudo_id
description: Random per-install identifier (16 random bytes, hex). Not a user id.

name: session_id
description: Random identifier for one app session.

name: session_number
description: Lifetime session counter for this install, starting at 1.

name: screen
description: Screen context at event time (boot, home, game, result, ad, league, language, out_of_lives).

name: level
description: Level context at event time, 1-based; 0 when no level is active.

name: params
description: Event-specific parameters as a JSON object. Values are int, float or string; booleans are stored as 0/1.

name: user_properties
description: Latest GA4-style user properties repeated on every row: max_level, trophies, hints, carrots, no_ads, language.

name: app_version
description: application/config/version at event time.

name: engine_version
description: Godot engine version string.

name: platform
description: OS.get_name() (Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS).

name: os_version
description: Operating system version string.

name: device_model
description: Hardware model name as reported by the OS.

name: device_brand
description: Processor name reported by the OS (approximates device brand).

name: cpu_count
description: Logical processor count.

name: gpu_vendor
description: Rendering adapter vendor.

name: gpu_name
description: Rendering adapter name.

name: screen_w
description: Screen width in pixels.

name: screen_h
description: Screen height in pixels.

name: locale
description: OS locale, e.g. tr_TR.

name: language
description: In-game language code.

name: is_mobile
description: 1 when the mobile feature tag is present, else 0.

name: is_debug
description: 1 for a debug build, else 0.

name: region_eea
description: 1 when the OS locale country is in the EEA/UK/CH list, else 0.
